PlanetX_Basic.Crash: Check whether the collision sensor is pressed.
PlanetX_Basic.Dust: Read dust concentration in micrograms per cubic metre.
PlanetX_Basic.MP3SetPort: Initialize the serial port connected to the MP3 module.

PlanetX_Display.TM1637LEDs.showNumber: Show a number on the four-digit LED display.
PlanetX_Display.TM1637LEDs.showbit: Show a single digit at the selected display position.
